ai_summary: 5paisa Capital Limited announced a significantly favorable outcome in its appeal against an Income Tax order for A.Y. 2023-24. The company was granted relief of ₹40.03 crore, substantially reducing the initial additions/disallowances of ₹42.90 crore. This positive development mitigates a major potential tax liability, with the company planning to contest the remaining disallowance of ₹2.87 crore.
